deadline.intake: Bachelor entry 2027 (deadline shown on the International Bachelor Communication and Media page; proof of English for non-EEA students by 1 May)

tuition.note: Non-EEA bachelor students 2027-2028 (ESSB, ESPhil, ESHCC, ESHPM, ESL, ESE); RSM 15,200; EUC 17,800

requirement.text: International applicants submit their secondary/high school diploma and final grade list (a diploma statement is accepted with a conditional offer) and pay a non-refundable EUR 100 application fee for a non-Dutch diploma.
